name: Restic
description: Protects against destructive restic operations like forgetting snapshots, pruning data, removing keys, and cache cleanup.

destructive_patterns.name: restic-forget
destructive_patterns.description: restic forget removes snapshots and can permanently delete backup data.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
restic forget removes snapshots from repository:

\ - Snapshot metadata removed from repository \ - Data not deleted until prune is run \ - Use --keep-* flags to retain recent snapshots \ - --dry-run shows what would be forgotten

\ Preview first: restic forget --dry-run [options]

destructive_patterns.name: restic-prune
destructive_patterns.description: restic prune removes unreferenced data and is irreversible.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
restic prune permanently deletes unreferenced data:

\ - Removes data no longer referenced by snapshots \ - Usually run after 'restic forget' \ - Cannot be undone - data is permanently deleted \ - May take a long time for large repositories

\ Consider: restic forget --prune to combine operations

destructive_patterns.name: restic-key-remove
destructive_patterns.description: restic key remove deletes encryption keys and can make backups unrecoverable.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
restic key remove deletes repository encryption keys:

\ - Key is permanently deleted from repository \ - If all keys removed, repository becomes inaccessible \ - Cannot recover data without a valid key \ - Always keep at least one key available

\ List keys first: restic key list

destructive_patterns.name: restic-unlock-remove-all
destructive_patterns.explanation:
restic unlock --remove-all force-removes all locks:

\ - Removes locks from potentially active operations \ - May cause corruption if operations are in progress \ - Use only when locks are stale/orphaned

\ Check first: ensure no other restic processes are running

destructive_patterns.name: restic-cache-cleanup
destructive_patterns.description: restic cache --cleanup removes cached data from disk.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
restic cache --cleanup removes local cache:

\ - Deletes cached data from local disk \ - Does not affect repository data \ - Cache will be rebuilt on next operation \ - May slow down subsequent operations

\ Lower risk: only affects local cache, not backups
